python3 - <<'PY'
import os,json,tomllib,subprocess,shlex
from pathlib import Path
stage=Path.home()/'.cache/photomap-rsync-relay-20261101-v1'
print('MAC_RELAY_ABSENT='+str(not stage.exists() and not stage.is_symlink()),flush=True)
assert not stage.exists() and not stage.is_symlink()
h=tomllib.loads((Path.home()/'.config/host-ops/config.toml').read_text())['hosts']['pi-zero']
script=r'''set -u
ROOT=/home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
printf 'PI_EXPORT_ABSENT='; if test ! -e "$ROOT/.dev/rsync-export-20261101-v1"; then echo yes; else echo no; fi
printf 'PI_PRODUCTION_DB_PRESENT='; test -s "$ROOT/backend/data/app.db" && echo yes || echo no
printf 'PI_PRIVATE_COUNT='; find "$ROOT/backend/storage/private" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l
printf 'PI_PUBLIC_COUNT='; find "$ROOT/backend/storage/public" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l
printf 'PI_PROD_HEALTH='; curl -sS --max-time 9 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8000/health || true
printf 'PI_PHOTOMAP_SYSTEMD='; systemctl is-active photomap.service || true
printf 'PI_CLOUDFLARED='; systemctl is-active cloudflared.service || true
printf 'PI_GIT_HEAD='; git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --short HEAD || true
printf 'PI_GIT_DIRTY_COUNT='; git -C "$ROOT" status --porcelain=v1 | wc -l
'''
argv=['ssh','-i',str(Path(h['identity_file']).expanduser()),'-p',str(h['port']),'-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','IdentitiesOnly=yes','-o','StrictHostKeyChecking=yes','-o','ConnectTimeout=10',str(h['user'])+'@'+str(h['host']),'bash -c '+shlex.quote(script)]
p=subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=70)
print('PI_FINAL='+json.dumps({'exit':p.returncode,'out':p.stdout[-2600:],'err':p.stderr[-800:]},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
assert p.returncode==0 and 'PI_EXPORT_ABSENT=yes' in p.stdout and 'PI_PROD_HEALTH=200' in p.stdout and 'PI_PHOTOMAP_SYSTEMD=active' in p.stdout and 'PI_CLOUDFLARED=active' in p.stdout
PY
